title: NAFEMS LE6 skew plate under normal pressure (MITC4 shells)
source: NAFEMS, The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks, TNSB Rev. 3, October 1990, test LE6 (target: maximum principal stress 0.802 MPa on the lower surface at E, the centre of the plate), as reproduced in the Abaqus 2016 Benchmarks Guide, section 4.2.6 'LE6: Skew plate under normal pressure', and in the ESRD StressCheck Benchmarks Guide 'The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks: Linear Elastic Tests' (2018), p. 19, which also gives its converged thin-solid result, 0.820 MPa (p. 20), and notes that its thin-solid formulation can differ from the plate model behind the target (p. 22)

quantities.quantity: maximum principal stress at E (933.01, 250), lower surface
quantities.reason: the target is published to three figures for the thin-plate model of the problem
quantities.known_failure: the target is a thin-plate value; at the specified 10 mm the transverse shear deformation the MITC4 shell keeps raises it to 0.8197 (+2.2%; converged about 0.821), as ESRD's converged thin-solid model does (quantity s1_E_solid), and thinner plates move towards 0.802 only slowly (about 0.809 at 1 mm, see README); FieldCraft has no thin-plate (Kirchhoff) element

quantities.quantity: maximum principal stress at E (933.01, 250), lower surface, against the converged thin-solid model
quantities.reason: a model that keeps transverse shear, like ESRD's thin solid, which reports 0.820 on two meshes (0.822 with triangles); ours is 0.8197 and the next refinement moves it by 0.15% (see README)
